key: folk:wolf:The Threshold Stalker|crawler|mimic|charcoal|A cottage in Vermont, 12:37 AM|

narrator.persona: a twenty-four-year-old locksmith living alone in a rural valley

sentences.text: If darkness follows you at night in Vermont, don't look back.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The police said my brother's car was found empty by the bridge with the keys still in the ignition.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I was sitting on the edge of my mattress when the heavy front door began to rattle.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Then his familiar voice called out from the porch steps through the splintered wood.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It sounded completely right except for the cold way he pronounced my full name.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I crept across the dark floorboards and pressed my eye against the peephole to see the charcoal shape waiting on the other side.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Can you hear that exact scratching at your front door tonight?
sentences.speaker: narrator
